name: commandeck
description: An orchestrated build workflow for Claude Code on Orca: one orchestrator session, one Builder per batch in its own worktree, review passes until GO, and a local squash merge.

orchestratorModel.title: Main model
orchestratorModel.description: The model main (the orchestrator) runs; setup writes it to the project's settings. project: Opus. Main cannot be off: it runs everything.

orchestratorEffort.title: Main effort
orchestratorEffort.description: Main's reasoning effort; setup writes it to the project's settings. project: medium.

builderModel.title: Builder model
builderModel.description: The model each Builder runs. project: Sonnet. A Builder cannot be off: with none there is no branch to review or merge.

builderEffort.title: Builder effort
builderEffort.description: The Builder's reasoning effort. project: high. A launch may raise it for one build.

fixerEnabled.title: Fixer
fixerEnabled.description: On: the fix rounds of a build follow the Fixer settings below. Off: every fix round keeps the Builder's launched model and effort.

fixerFirstModel.title: Fixer model, first fix round
fixerFirstModel.description: The model of a build's first fix round. project: Opus. builder: the Builder's launched model.

fixerFirstEffort.title: Fixer effort, first fix round
fixerFirstEffort.description: The effort of a build's first fix round. project: high. builder: the Builder's launched effort, a per-build raise included.

fixerModel.title: Fixer model, later fix rounds
fixerModel.description: The model of a build's second and later fix rounds. project: Opus.

fixerEffort.title: Fixer effort, later fix rounds
fixerEffort.description: The effort of a build's second and later fix rounds. project: high.

codexReviewerAgent.title: Reviewer
codexReviewerAgent.description: Who runs the review passes: codex, or claude (a headless read-only Claude session). project: codex, or claude on the Claude-only profile. The reviewer cannot be off: the merge needs a GO pass.

codexReviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
codexReviewerModel.description: On codex: a family (sol, astra) or a model id (gpt-6.1-sol). On claude: opus, sonnet or fable. project: sol, or sonnet on claude.

codexReviewerEffort.title: Reviewer effort
codexReviewerEffort.description: The review pass's reasoning effort. project: medium, or high on claude.

codexReviewerFast.title: Reviewer fast tier
codexReviewerFast.description: The review passes run on the fast tier, which costs more. On codex it needs service_tier = "fast" in Codex's config.toml.

planAuthorEnabled.title: Plan author
planAuthorEnabled.description: On: main asks for a plan before a build when the plan tier wants one. Off: no plan; builds launch with --skip-plan.

planAuthorModel.title: Plan author model
planAuthorModel.description: The model that writes the plan. project: Opus.

planAuthorEffort.title: Plan author effort
planAuthorEffort.description: The plan author's reasoning effort. project: high.

planAuthorFast.title: Plan author fast tier
planAuthorFast.description: The plan author runs on the fast tier, which costs more.

planJudgeSolEnabled.title: Sol judge
planJudgeSolEnabled.description: On: the Sol judge reads the plan. Off: the Astra judge judges alone, and with both off the plan installs unjudged.

planJudgeSolAgent.title: Sol judge agent
planJudgeSolAgent.description: codex, or claude (a read-only Claude pane). project: codex, or claude on the Claude-only profile.

planJudgeSolModel.title: Sol judge model
planJudgeSolModel.description: On codex: a family or a model id. On claude: opus, sonnet or fable. project: sol, or sonnet on claude.

planJudgeSolEffort.title: Sol judge effort
planJudgeSolEffort.description: The Sol judge's reasoning effort. project: high.

planJudgeSolFast.title: Sol judge fast tier
planJudgeSolFast.description: The Sol judge runs on the fast tier, which costs more. On codex it needs service_tier = "fast" in Codex's config.toml.

planJudgeAstraEnabled.title: Astra judge
planJudgeAstraEnabled.description: On: the Astra judge reads the plan on the Panel tier. Off: the Sol judge judges alone.

planJudgeAstraAgent.title: Astra judge agent
planJudgeAstraAgent.description: codex, or claude (a read-only Claude pane). project: codex, or claude on the Claude-only profile.

planJudgeAstraModel.title: Astra judge model
planJudgeAstraModel.description: On codex: a family or a model id. On claude: opus, sonnet or fable. project: astra, or sonnet on claude.

planJudgeAstraEffort.title: Astra judge effort
planJudgeAstraEffort.description: The Astra judge's reasoning effort. project: high.

planJudgeAstraFast.title: Astra judge fast tier
planJudgeAstraFast.description: The Astra judge runs on the fast tier, which costs more. On codex it needs service_tier = "fast" in Codex's config.toml.

maxReviewRounds.title: Review rounds
maxReviewRounds.description: The most review passes a build may run. Empty: no cap.

maxBuilders.title: Builder cap
maxBuilders.description: The most Builders that may run at once, over all units. Empty: no cap.

wakeKinds.title: Wake kinds
wakeKinds.description: Orca message types that wake main, comma-separated. Others are held and shown at the next wake.

wakeWindowSeconds.title: Wake window (seconds)
wakeWindowSeconds.description: Actionable messages that arrive within this many seconds wake main once. 0: each wakes at once.

closingPass.title: Closing pass
closingPass.description: After the narrowed review passes end GO, one more pass reads the whole branch, and its GO merges.

fullSuiteBeforeFinal.title: Full suite before the final review
fullSuiteBeforeFinal.description: The closing review pass runs the project's test command once on the build's tip.

ponytail.title: Ponytail
ponytail.description: Worker panes run the ponytail skill's smallest-change coding rules.

promptCacheTtl.title: Prompt cache
promptCacheTtl.description: 5m: main and worker panes keep their prompt cache 5 minutes. leave: nothing is written.

relayPromptCacheTtl.title: Relay prompt cache
relayPromptCacheTtl.description: 1h: the relay pane keeps its prompt cache 1 hour. leave: nothing is written.

dashboardBind.title: Dashboard address
dashboardBind.description: The address the dashboard listens on: 127.0.0.1 is this machine only. Applies at the next setup.

dashboardPort.title: Dashboard port
dashboardPort.description: The dashboard's port. Empty: the first free port from 8791. Applies at the next setup.
